duration: School year volunteering begins the week of Monday, September 14 (no year printed; the weekday matches 2026)
name: Teen Volunteers and Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help in the Digital Creator Lab, run D&D games, shelve books and decorate Teenspace. You also help at programs. The Teen Library Council plans programs and recommends books. Teens help plan a Haunted Activity House for kids and families on October 30.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 6 to 12 can earn service hours. There are separate Teen Library Council groups for middle school and high school.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. School year volunteering begins the week of Monday, September 14 (no year printed; the weekday matches 2026). Haunted House planning meetings start in spring.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Interest Form. Or fill out the Teen Library Council form. Questions: teenread@wheatonlibrary.org.
notes: You can also earn hours by making cards. Four cards earn 1 volunteer hour. You can also write book reviews. Each review earns 30 minutes of service hours.
